requirement:
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.

When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
rationale:
The code and tests cover every obligation in `requirements.definitions.authoring_inputs`. I found no gaps.

**Obligations and the code that carries them out**

1. **Terms referenced by the subject must contribute their complete declaration, including the phrase option.**
   - `AssessmentSources::prepare` in `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[prepare]` passes `subject.text` to `definition_inputs`, which calls `crate::terms::dependencies`.
   - `direct_references` in `src/terms.rs` extracts `{term}` references from the subject text.
   - `source_input` with an `InputSelector::Definition` returns the whole definition. The tests confirm it starts with `:::{definition}` and `:phrase:`.

2. **Terms referenced by any contributed source must also contribute.**
   - `prepare` passes the already-built `mandatory` inputs to `definition_inputs`.
   - `direct_references` scans each input's text. It scans only the comments of Rust files, requirement bodies, and other files as Markdown or plain text. It also resolves recorded outline inputs that carry no text.

3. **Definitions referenced by those definitions must be included transitively.**
   - `close_dependencies` in `src/terms.rs` expands to a fixed point.

4. **There must be no duplicates and no nontermination on cycles.**
   - `close_dependencies` keeps a `visited` set and a `BTreeSet` of required names.
   - `prepare` also skips an input already in `mandatory`.

5. **A read that adds a terminology dependency must supply the same complete, transitive set to the model.**
   - `read` in `src/authoring/tools.rs` calls `additional_definitions`, which reuses `definition_inputs`. It excludes definitions already recorded or already in the delivered inputs.
   - Line-range reads go through `dispatch_paged`, whose `pages.deliver` uses `definitions_each`. Each page carries its own definitions.

6. **The set must be recorded before a submission is accepted.**
   - `converse` in `src/authoring/mod.rs` delivers the tool results, which include the definitions. It then calls `sources.record_inputs(&pending)` on the next response, before it parses the submission.

**Tests**

- `mod[tests]/fn[bundle_combines_direct_references_terms_and_current_existing_selectors]` in `src/authoring/inputs.rs` covers the initial set. `terms.unit` and `terms.value` reference each other, so it exercises a cycle. It asserts exactly two definition inputs and a transitive reference from the subject.
- `mod[tests]/fn[mandatory_git_inputs_require_staging_declarations_sources_and_terms]` in `src/authoring/inputs.rs` covers a term referenced only from a contributed source. Once the files are staged, the term definition is supplied.
- `mod[tests]/fn[definitions_introduced_by_a_read_are_supplied_and_recorded_before_submission]` in `src/authoring/mod.rs` covers a read that introduces a term. It checks that the transitive set appears once, in the recorded evidence inputs, with the phrase line intact. It also checks that the definitions were delivered to the model before the submission.
- `mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]` in `src/authoring/tools.rs` checks the definitions that come with outline and line-range reads, and that they are recorded.
- `mod[tests]/fn[paged_inputs_carry_their_definitions_and_deliver_only_their_own_inputs]` in `src/authoring/pages.rs` checks that definitions travel with the page that needs them.

There is no `{fixme}` against this requirement.

text: :::{req} authoring_inputs
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.
When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
:::{req} mandatory_inputs
The harness MUST construct each assessment's mandatory input set by combining
the contributions specified by the requirements applicable to that subject and
its inputs. A requirement that contributes inputs MUST cite this requirement and
define which sources it contributes and when. The harness MUST include every
applicable contribution, deduplicate identical selections, and report
unresolvable mandatory inputs before inference. The complete set MUST be supplied
in the initial model request.
Generated output under project-root `evidence/`, including symlink aliases, MUST
be omitted from mandatory inputs when the default exclusion applies. An explicit
workspace allow MUST permit those selections; an explicit disallow MUST abort
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.read_denial`.
